_comment: Two-tier T1a (docs/2026-09-16_two_tier_transformer_feasibility.zh.md §10.3): a learned short-horizon control layer told the TRUTH's plan (plan_conditioning=truth-next, the plan head's own label read at the anchor) and arrival time (cta_conditioning=given), trained at random anchors so it can be asked anywhere, and flown in lockstep by `run_ts.py tracker_lockstep` (re-asked every 30 s on its own flown rows, the truth expert read at the flown pose). PROTOCOL C: it reads the future (the plan and the arrival time) and is never a prediction result; its comparison is the rule guidance flying the same plan (plan_oracle lockstep, design §12.5: vectored 1847 m / straight-in 283 m at L-1) and L3_cta's one-shot with only the truth duration (vectored 1596 m). CONTROL CONTRACT specific-force+path-angle (sf design §14-15; merged 82e27e8, one registry row since the 2026-09-16 contract refactor, feasibility doc §11): the head commands n_x, bank and a path-angle target, so the 'fully flyable' half of G1 is reachable at all (the thrust-fraction twin flies 0.4 % of flights fully flyable, the path-angle arms 97.7 %); the heading-rate term reads the load the path loop resolved. Supervision = A2b's random-anchor recipe (heading-rate 8 + bank TV 1 + velocity 0.003, no imitation: random anchors + imitation is the known performance cliff), remaining-path-uniform anchors with half the draws reserved for L-1, 180 epochs without early stopping; selection on the fixed-anchor common-grid ADE (the anchor-grid metric is refused under a read-the-future input). Single airport KRDU, val split only; the airport-balanced sampler is not exercised. PRE-REGISTERED GATE G1 (both seeds of the p=0.5 arm, read off tracker_lockstep's `receding` variant at L-1): vectored ADE < 1000 m AND straight-in ADE < 200 m; fully flyable >= 95 % and established >= 88 % of the guidance's share (python -m evaluation on the records). Readings beside the gate: `receding-no-plan` (the absent token on the same weights: what the plan buys), `one-shot` (what re-asking buys), T1a_plan_p0 (risk 2: a model never shown the absent token — does it over-rely on the plan?). If G1 fails with per-ask drift (e(30 s) against the truth rising along the flight), T1c (rolled-state targets) becomes the next step.
